reviewedBy: Claude (Opus 5), session 57b768fe, reading the /api/capture?draft output with Jacob Kennedy
source: bookmarklet capture, 11 of 11 products, sitemap agreed
review: A small, coherent shop: five card games and four garments. Complete capture, everything priced, everything has an image. Published whole.

The feed types the same thing two ways, 'card game' and 'Card Game'. Listed ONCE: row() compares include entries case-insensitively, so the second spelling is covered and listing it again would only imply the matching is case-sensitive.
The garments carry the store's own types and the store's default room is `play`, so roomMap sends them to the Wardrobe. Without it four products would be filed under Play.

COSTS TWO PRODUCTS, KNOWINGLY. Two items have no product_type at all, and a non-empty include list drops every untyped product because the empty string matches no entry. One of the two was refused by the classifier anyway; the other is a garment. Losing one real product is the price of keeping the include list honest here, and it is the safe direction to fail in.
